header_basis: A last-four search offers the producer's directory entry whose masked discriminator carries the tail, of ANY kind (no kind filter): infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/directory/handler.py:171-212 search(). The option row keeps the entry's kind (header/search.ts:62-64, toOptionRow :111-130); ClientSearch.tsx:127-131 browses and shapes the rows, :166-173 handleSelect -> selectionFor (search.ts:275-290). The kind comes from permitted_scope.scope_kind (contracts/adapt.ts:429-434 KIND_FOR_SCOPE_KIND, :629) and accountId is set only for kind account (adapt.ts:679). selectionRequest.ts:8-18 sends ACCOUNT only for a narrowedToAccount selection, otherwise CLIENT for a client row or RELATIONSHIP for a relationship row. The producer fixture for the last-four shape is kind relationship, accountId null, maskedDiscriminator ****4417 (portal src/pages/InvestorReporting/fixtures/directoryEntry.success.json). ACCOUNT-kind entries exist only for an account with no relationship above it (infra/.../directory/tests/fixtures.py:67-69 ACCOUNT_ONLY). So for an account inside a relationship the option is a RELATIONSHIP-kind row, a non-ACCOUNT row (recorded as CLIENT_ROW in this enum; its exact kind is relationship). Basis is the fixture and code path; no live search was made. See surprise DSGN_IRPTV1-D2-W69-S1.
